prompt: Hero is UTG with AsKd on Kh-8d-3c-2s after BB checks twice. Hero's top-pair range keeps the better board fit and can pressure weaker continues to fold. Choose the best action.
why_v1: Raise applies pressure when board fit and range edge can make weaker continues fold.
feedback_correct_v1: Correct. Raising fits because the board fit and range edge create pressure against weaker continues.
feedback_incorrect_v1: Incorrect. Calling would underuse the board fit and range edge; this spot can pressure weaker continues with a raise.
